title: Sales By Representative Expanded CSV and PDF look as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "sbr-11-a4-export-csv.png" (board 4.11) and "sbr-12-a4-export-pdf-crop-1.png" (board 4.12) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Today has one invoiced split work order (Labor {Sales-rep-A}, Parts {Sales-rep-B}).
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Representative is open in that browser window, with the Sales Type column off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Export the Expanded CSV and compare it with the picture of board 4.11.
  2. Export the Expanded PDF and compare it with the picture of board 4.12.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the file has the Sales Type column after Status even though it is off on screen; the cells of the side a row is not credited with are blank.
  • Step 2: the PDF has the Sales Type column after Status; those cells show a dash; the header lines name the filters, including "Sales Type: All".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative), story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • S5-R23: “The Expanded CSV and the Expanded PDF always carry the Sales Type column, after Status, whatever the screen shows. In them, the cells of the side a row is not credited with are blank in the CSV and show a dash in the PDF.”
  • S8-R4: “The filter line at the top of every PDF and CSV export of Sales By Representative reads the same: "Sales Type: All", or the selected names. With no option selected there is nothing to export: Export shows "Empty export" and makes no file.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 4.11 Expanded export (CSV); 4.12 Expanded export (PDF) (the attached pictures are these boards).

Where the design and the PRD differ: The export pictures show 0.00 / $0.00 under Shop Supplies on the Parts row; the PRD says blank in the CSV and a dash in the PDF. This case follows the PRD; the difference is on the product owner's question sheet.

Design pictures attached to this case: sbr-11-a4-export-csv.png, sbr-12-a4-export-pdf-crop-1.png.

  • Design — board 4.11 title: “4.11 Expanded export (CSV)”
  • Design — board 4.11 note: “Downloaded with the Sales Type column switched off on screen: the file still has Sales Type (decision 40). An empty side is a blank cell. (Shown as a spreadsheet would open it.)”
  • Design — board 4.12 title: “4.12 Expanded export (PDF)”
  • Design — board 4.12 note: “The PDF always has the Sales Type column. An empty side shows a dash. Header lines name the filters, including "Sales Type: All".”
